result.instructions: Tools for Auvik, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which devices in our client networks are offline right now?"; "Show the critical alerts raised in the last 24 hours, with their devices."; "How much bandwidth did this router use per hour yesterday?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Auvik data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run auvik_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run auvik_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run auvik_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. auvik_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: auvik_list_tenants
tools.title: List tenants
tools.description: List the tenants (clients and multi-clients) this Auvik user can access. Call this first: the tenant IDs feed the tenants filter of the other tools. Auvik API: GET /v1/tenants.

tools.name: auvik_list_devices
tools.title: List devices
tools.description: List devices Auvik discovered, with name, type, make and model, IP addresses and online status. Filter by network, status or last-seen time. Auvik API: GET /v1/inventory/device/info.

tenants.description: Comma-separated tenant IDs from auvik_list_tenants. Omit to use the vendor default.

notSeenSince.description: Devices last seen online before this UTC time.

modifiedAfter.description: Devices modified after this UTC time.

after.description: Cursor: links.next from the previous page.

tools.name: auvik_get_device
tools.title: Get a device
tools.description: Get one device by ID with its name, type, make and model, IP addresses and online status. Auvik API: GET /v1/inventory/device/info/{id}.

tools.name: auvik_list_networks
tools.title: List networks
tools.description: List networks Auvik discovered (routed, VLAN, Wi-Fi, layer 2 and others), with name, type and scan status. Auvik API: GET /v1/inventory/network/info.

tenants.description: Comma-separated tenant IDs from auvik_list_tenants. Omit to use the vendor default.

modifiedAfter.description: Networks modified after this UTC time.

after.description: Cursor: links.next from the previous page.

tools.name: auvik_get_network
tools.title: Get a network
tools.description: Get one network by ID with its name, type, scan status and description. Auvik API: GET /v1/inventory/network/info/{id}.

tools.name: auvik_list_interfaces
tools.title: List interfaces
tools.description: List device interfaces with name, type, MAC and IP addresses, speed, and admin and operational status. Auvik API: GET /v1/inventory/interface/info.

tenants.description: Comma-separated tenant IDs from auvik_list_tenants. Omit to use the vendor default.

deviceId.description: Only interfaces of this device ID.

interfaceType.description: Interface type, for example ethernet or wifi.

adminStatus.description: true = admin up, false = admin down.

modifiedAfter.description: Interfaces modified after this UTC time.

after.description: Cursor: links.next from the previous page.

tools.name: auvik_list_alerts
tools.title: List alerts
tools.description: List alerts Auvik raised, with severity, status, detection time and dismissed flag. Filter by severity, status, time window or device. Auvik API: GET /v1/alert/history/info.

tenants.description: Comma-separated tenant IDs from auvik_list_tenants. Omit to use the vendor default.

detectedAfter.description: Alerts detected after this UTC time.

detectedBefore.description: Alerts detected at or before this UTC time.

entityId.description: Only alerts on this entity (device or network) ID.

alertDefinitionId.description: Only alerts from this alert definition ID.

after.description: Cursor: links.next from the previous page.

tools.name: auvik_get_alert
tools.title: Get an alert
tools.description: Get one alert by ID with its name, description, severity, status and external ticket data. Auvik API: GET /v1/alert/history/info/{id}.

tools.name: auvik_dismiss_alert
tools.title: Dismiss an alert
tools.description: Dismiss one alert in Auvik, so it no longer shows as active. This changes alert state in Auvik; call it only when the user asks. Auvik API: POST /v1/alert/dismiss/{id}.

tools.name: auvik_get_device_statistics
tools.title: Get device statistics
tools.description: Get device metrics over a time range: bandwidth, CPU, memory, storage or packet counts, per minute, hour or day. Auvik API: GET /v1/stat/device/{statId}.

tenants.description: Comma-separated tenant IDs from auvik_list_tenants. Omit to use the vendor default.

thruTime.description: End of the range, UTC. Default: now.

deviceType.description: Only devices of this type, for example accessPoint.

after.description: Cursor: links.next from the previous page.

tools.name: auvik_get_client_usage
tools.title: Get client usage
tools.description: Get the usage summary of a client and its child tenants for a date range. Auvik API: GET /v1/billing/usage/client.

tenants.description: Comma-separated tenant IDs from auvik_list_tenants. Omit to use the vendor default.
